# Flashscore

> > Flashscore provides real-time live scores, results, and fixtures across 30+ sports including football, tennis, basketball, hockey, handball, and baseball worldwide.

Flashscore is a comprehensive sports livescore platform covering major leagues like Germany's Bundesliga, Italy's Serie A, Japan's NPB baseball, and the Euro Hockey Tour, as well as regional competitions from Mongolia to Cape Verde. The site delivers instant match updates, standings, and statistics for professional and amateur sports globally.
